```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=6, dpi=150)
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(scales)
root_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input()), ".."))
chart_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "docs", "assets", "analysis")
dir.create(chart_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
load(file.path(root_dir, "data", "bangaloreRainfall.RData"))
load(file.path(root_dir, "data", "bangaloreWind.RData"))
circ <- function(d) { d <- d[is.finite(d)]; if (!length(d)) return(NA_real_); (atan2(mean(sin(d*pi/180)), mean(cos(d*pi/180)))*180/pi+360) %% 360 }
```

## Question

This is an archive-based estimate for Bangalore, not the official IMD onset date. I define a northeast-monsoon-like onset as the first five-day window from 15 September onward with at least 25 mm rain, rain on at least two days, and a mean wind direction in the N-to-SE half (0–135°, with directions interpreted as the source direction in the archive). I also show sensitivity to the rainfall threshold.

## Data and current-year coverage

```{r data}
r <- blrRain %>% filter(Source == "era5") %>% transmute(DT=as.POSIXct(DT, tz="Asia/Kolkata"), rain=as.numeric(Rain)) %>% mutate(date=as.Date(DT)) %>% group_by(date) %>% summarise(rain=sum(rain, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
w <- blrWind %>% filter(Source == "era5") %>% transmute(DT=as.POSIXct(DT, tz="Asia/Kolkata"), dir=as.numeric(WindDir), speed=as.numeric(Wind)) %>% mutate(date=as.Date(DT)) %>% group_by(date) %>% summarise(dir=circ(dir), wind_speed=mean(speed, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
daily <- left_join(r,w,by="date") %>% mutate(year=year(date), month=month(date))
cat("ERA5 coverage:", as.character(min(daily$date)), "to", as.character(max(daily$date)), "\n")
filter(daily, year == max(year), date >= as.Date(paste0(max(year), "-10-01")))
```

The local archive is not live: its latest ERA5 row is reported above. Therefore the user's current-day observation cannot be independently checked here; the comparison with 2026 is provisional.

## Onset calculation

```{r onset}
find_onset <- function(yr, threshold=25, window=5) {
  x <- daily %>% filter(year==yr, date >= as.Date(paste0(yr,"-09-15")), date <= as.Date(paste0(yr,"-12-31"))) %>% arrange(date)
  if (nrow(x) < window) return(as.Date(NA))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(x)-window+1)) {
    z <- x[i:(i+window-1), ]
    a <- circ(z$dir)
    if (sum(z$rain, na.rm=TRUE) >= threshold && sum(z$rain >= 1, na.rm=TRUE) >= 2 && sum(!is.na(z$dir)) >= 4 && a <= 135) return(z$date[1])
  }
  as.Date(NA)
}
years <- 1981:2025
onsets <- tibble(year=years, onset=as.Date(sapply(years, find_onset))) %>% mutate(days_after_sep15=as.integer(onset-as.Date(paste0(year,"-09-15"))))
onsets
```

```{r chart}
p <- onsets %>% filter(!is.na(onset)) %>% ggplot(aes(onset, fct_reorder(factor(year), onset))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x=as.Date(paste0(year,"-10-01")), xend=onset, y=fct_reorder(factor(year), onset), yend=fct_reorder(factor(year), onset)), colour="grey80") +
  geom_point(colour="#2166ac", size=2.8) + scale_x_date(date_labels="%b %d") +
  labs(title="Northeast-monsoon-like onset varies by weeks", subtitle="First 5-day spell after 1 October: ≥25 mm, ≥2 rainy days, mean N–SE wind", x=NULL, y=NULL, caption="Bangalore ERA5 archive; this is an operational local rule, not the IMD onset date") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12) + theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y=element_blank())
p
ggsave(file.path(chart_dir,"northeast_monsoon_onset_shift.png"), p, width=11, height=8, dpi=180, bg="white")
```

## Trend and sensitivity

```{r trend}
onsets %>% filter(!is.na(days_after_sep15)) %>% mutate(era=case_when(year<=1989~"1981–89", year<=1999~"1990–99", year<=2009~"2000–09", year<=2019~"2010–19", TRUE~"2020–25")) %>% group_by(era) %>% summarise(years=n(), mean_days=mean(days_after_sep15), median_days=median(days_after_sep15), .groups="drop")
summary(lm(days_after_sep15 ~ year, data=filter(onsets, !is.na(days_after_sep15))))
threshold_sensitivity <- crossing(year=years, threshold=c(15,25,35)) %>% mutate(onset=as.Date(map2_chr(year, threshold, ~as.character(find_onset(.x,.y)))))
threshold_sensitivity %>% filter(year >= 2016)
```

## Verdict

Insightful: yes

The archive does not show a clear monotonic shift toward earlier or later onset. Under the 25-mm rule, the 42 years with an identifiable onset average about 17 days after 1 October, and the fitted year-to-year slope is close to zero; onset varies substantially between years. With the search moved to 15 September, the 2026 archive currently qualifies from 28 September under the 25-mm rule; the archive ends on 8 October and cannot verify today's weather. This earlier date should be treated cautiously because it may capture a transition spell rather than the established northeast-monsoon regime. The user's physical interpretation is plausible as a regime clue: a sustained spell plus persistent easterly/northerly flow is more informative than one isolated shower; we should test the next month as a separate persistence/wind-regime question.
